newsitem.title: USA: Murphy Oil spinning off Deltic Farm unit.
newsitem.headline: Murphy Oil spinning off Deltic Farm unit.

text.p: Murphy Oil Corp said its board has approved the spin off of its Deltic Farm & Timber Co Inc unit to stockholders.
Deltic is Murphy's wholly owned farm, timber and real estate unit.
Murphy said that as a result of the transaction, Murphy and Deltic will be two separately owned and managed companies.

The spin off will increase the ability of Deltic to achieve and finance accelerated growth, allow managment to focus on core businesses and enable financial markets to value each of the companies more effectively, Murphy said.

The distribution is subject to the confirmation of the tax free nature of the transaction. Once conditions are satisfied, the distribution will be pro rata to all Murphy stockholders as of a record date to be established.
Murphy said it expects the distribution to take place before year end.
